description: Post-1.0 Phase 17 — Play internal/closed testing track: upload signed AAB from CI, invite testers, triage crashes/ANRs via Play Console Android Vitals (no first-party Crashlytics SDK).

tracks.note: Start on internal (fast), promote the same AAB to closed when the tester list grows.

upload.consolePath: Play Console → Fish Shopping → Testing → Internal testing → Create new release

testers.licenseTesters: Play Console → Setup → License testing (for IAP sandbox)
testers.emailList: Internal testing → Testers → email list or Google Group
testers.inviteNote: Share the opt-in link; testers need the Play Store account that was invited.

crashTriage.note: No Crashlytics/Firebase Crash SDK in 1.0. Use Play Console → Quality → Android Vitals (crashes & ANRs) plus uploaded mapping.txt for deobfuscation.
triageSteps: Upload mapping.txt with the AAB (or via App bundle explorer) so stacks deobfuscate
After 24–48h of tester traffic, open Android Vitals → Crashes & ANRs
Reproduce top issues against Phase 13 device matrix (background/rotate/low-memory)
File blockers before promoting to production (Phase 18)
blockerCriteria: Startup crash rate above Play bad-behavior threshold for the track
ANR on cold start or onStop checkpoint path
IAP purchase/restore failures for license testers on internal track
Data loss after process death (AtomicFile slots empty)

checklist: CI android-release job produced AAB + mapping artifacts
Upload keystore secrets (not ephemeral CI key) used for the Play build
Internal track release created with pin versionName/versionCode
License testers configured; smoke IAP purchase + Restore
≥1 closed/internal tester installed via opt-in link
Android Vitals reviewed; no blockerCriteria open
Sign off before Phase 18 public production track

manualUploadCommands: Or: ./gradlew :app:bundleRelease  # with FISH_UPLOAD_* set to the Play upload keystore
Play Console → Internal testing → upload app-release.aab + ensure mapping attached
